annotations.text: League builder — Direction A, mobile-first, rounds 2–3 applied. 11 fixed rows (8 gyms, Elite 4, Champion, Endgame boss), team sizes 2/3/3/3/4/4/4/5/5/6/6, columns right-aligned with the always-present line on the right. Levels are invisible everywhere — the glyphs carry stage: N−1 filled diamonds + 1 outlined, 4 stars for Elite 4, outlined crown for Champion, filled crown for the boss. Flow reads left to right: League home → tap a row → its card → add a line → picker sheet.

League home (mobile start screen). 14 slots: 8 gyms, E4 with 1–4 stars, outlined-crown champion, filled-crown boss. Two placed: Water at gym 4, Steel at E2. Rows drag to reorder; a moved card re-derives its shown team.

The card. Fixed schedule fills columns; sprites sit at 44px. Champion row: Gyarados carries the Mega corner button (M), Lapras the Dynamax button (D) — form change, not a swap. Boss row: Suicune (crown badge) swapped into Gyarados's seat — the one legend cell swap.

Evo line picker — the dex builder's selection pane as a bottom sheet. Lines are grouped by branch: searching eevee returns one card per branch, so picking IS the branch choice. My 151 filter ships in v1.
Desktop port: league right, open card left, the active row fans out into the card pane. The picker overlays the league pane when open, so card and picker stay visible together.
